name: Plenm
tagline: The operating layer for enterprise HVAC service fleets
positioning: Plenm unifies dispatch, asset telemetry, and warranty compliance so multi-site facilities teams run every service call from one accountable system of record.

hero.h1: Every service call, accountable to one system
hero.sub: Plenm connects your dispatch board, rooftop unit telemetry, and warranty records into a single operating layer built for multi-site HVAC service fleets.

features.title: Telemetry-triggered dispatch
features.description: Rooftop and chiller sensors open a work order the moment a unit drifts out of spec — before a tenant ever files a hot-and-cold complaint.

features.title: Fleet-wide asset ledger
features.description: Track every compressor, coil, and filter across thousands of sites with full service history, runtime hours, and remaining warranty exposure.

features.title: Route-optimized technicians
features.description: Assign the right certified tech to the right site with live drive-time, truck-stock, and refrigerant-handling credentials factored in.

features.title: Warranty & compliance capture
features.description: Auto-attach EPA 608 logs, refrigerant charge records, and manufacturer warranty claims to each job so audits close in hours, not weeks.

features.title: SLA performance reporting
features.description: Board-ready dashboards prove first-visit fix rate, mean time to repair, and uptime against every enterprise service contract.

features.title: Preventive maintenance engine
features.description: Schedule seasonal changeovers and filter cycles per equipment class, then measure the emergency calls each program prevents.

testimonials.quote: Plenm cut our mean time to repair across 340 retail sites by 31%. Telemetry now opens the work order before the store manager even notices the sales floor is warm.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor

testimonials.quote: Warranty recovery used to leak six figures a year in missing refrigerant logs. With Plenm's asset ledger our audit trail is airtight and our claims actually get paid.
testimonials.name: Marcus Vandenberg

testimonials.quote: We consolidated four tools into Plenm. Dispatch, credentials, and SLA reporting live in one place, and our contract renewals now come with the numbers already on the table.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For regional service teams standardizing dispatch and asset history.
For multi-site fleets running preventive programs at volume.
For national operators with complex compliance and uptime mandates.
